column7: First-party finding (2026-10-27 silent-error-loss audit, finding 1), fixed in the public repo. ProjectMFABlocked let an interactive session without a second factor into an MFA-required project whenever the GetProject lookup error text contained "not found" (any storage error so worded skipped the per-project MFA gate); it now classifies with storage.IsProjectNotFound (ErrProjectNotFound wrapped by GetProject for gorm.ErrRecordNotFound only) and denies on every other error, in every locale.
